source.architecture_change: Rank prefixes by deterministic feedback completion to the same full horizon; preserve actual prefix objective separately.

objective: Unchanged from r2, full horizon prefix-progress/cross-track/heading/speed/20ms-footprint objective.
search: Width8,depth8,3steeringx3pedal expansion. Every prefix ranking evaluates its deterministic pursuit+target-speed feedback completion to depth8. Prefix costs are stored separately and never double-count completion costs.
regression: Frozen speed80 visible-road counterexample RED215footprint violations -> GREEN0; sequence cost must not exceed feasible constant braking.
limitations: Deterministic completion is still an approximate ranking estimate; no exhaustive optimality guarantee.
Unknown slip,positiveRPM saturation,undamaged asphalt assumption and uncertain geodesic topology remain.
25point footprint every20ms is not continuous safety certification.
previous_cost: r1sixinvalid_action andr2sixdrivingfailures permanently retained, not replaced by r3.
